paper_title: Searching for Scalar Dark Matter via Coupling to Fundamental Constants with Photonic, Atomic and Mechanical Oscillators
notes: Paper constrains both d_e (ScalarPhoton, alpha variation) and |d_me - d_g| across mass band 4.4e-19 to 6.8e-14 eV. Most sensitive limits quoted as d_e >~ 1.59e-1 and |d_me-dg| >~ 6.97e-1 at 95% CL via coefficient separation. Only the single best (most sensitive) values are given in text; full mass-dependent curve is in Fig. 3 but not numerically tabulated. I encoded the d_e best limit as an approximate horizontal band over the stated mass range - this is a rough representation, actual limit varies with mass. The |d_me-dg| combination would be ScalarElectron-related but paper's primary hint and the alpha/d_e constraint is ScalarPhoton. Density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.55, 2))
